validation_holdout.statement: Whole physical drives are held out (sessions grouped as src.analysis.drives.piece_units groups them). Drives are taken in a seeded random order: first, while an operating mode the model will score (at least MIN_CALIBRATION_SAMPLES independent windows) is missing from validation, the drive adding the most missing modes; then drives in order until validation holds validation_fraction of the windows. A drive is skipped when taking it would put more than twice that fraction in validation, leave no drive to train on, or leave a scored mode with fewer than MIN_CALIBRATION_SAMPLES independent training windows. With one drive (or none eligible) the validation set is a contiguous tail block, gapped by one window length.
